core_obligations: Condition (1): any representation of a simple factor Lie G_i extends to a representation of the direct sum that is zero on the other factors, so R-universality of Lie G forces R-universality of each Lie G_i (proof lines 914-916).
Condition (2): the same quadratic extension works for all factors; this is Lemma SameFixed, used as an external navigation pointer (proof lines 918-919).

Condition (3): compute D(Lie G, R)(lambda_i + lambda_j) as the tensor product of the two real division algebras, use R-universality of Lie G to get D(Lie G, Q)(lambda_i + lambda_j) Brauer-equivalent to Q, and conclude that the two quaternion algebras D(Lie G, Q)(lambda_i) and D(Lie G, Q)(lambda_j) are isomorphic (proof lines 921-932).

Condition (4): choose a dominant weight lambda_j of an outer factor that is not fixed by the star-action, so that lambda_i + lambda_j is not fixed either; then D(Lie G, Q)(lambda_i + lambda_j) becomes D(Lie G_i, L)(lambda_i) over L, and R-universality together with Lemma RunivIff(4) forces D(Lie G_i, L)(lambda_i) = L, hence D(Lie G, Q)(lambda_i) splits over L (proof lines 934-945).
The author states that only the forward implication is written out and that the argument is reversible, which is what makes the four conditions sufficient as well as necessary (proof lines 912-913).
proof_roadmap: 前三条：单因子的表示延拓给出 (1)；(2) 归到同一二次扩张；用 Brauer 等价与四元代数同构比较 D(Lie G_i, Q)(lambda_i) 之间的关系给出 (3)。
第四条：取不被 star 作用固定的权 lambda_j，把 D(Lie G, Q)(lambda_i + lambda_j) 在分裂域 L 上化到 D(Lie G_i, L)(lambda_i)，再由 R-universality 与 Lemma RunivIff(4) 得到在 L 上分裂。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the author's structure proposition for a direct sum of simple Lie algebras over Q (source lines 885-909): R-universality is equivalent to four simultaneous conditions on the simple factors, on the star-action, and on the Tits algebras of the factors. The proof (source lines 911-946) is not a routine assembly of earlier statements: condition (3) is a computation in the Brauer group, where the real division algebras attached to lambda_i and lambda_j are tensored, R-universality of the sum is used to force the tensor product to be Brauer equivalent to Q, and the conclusion that the two quaternion algebras are isomorphic uses that they are quaternion algebras (proof lines 921-932). Condition (4) needs the choice of an outer factor and a weight moved by the star-action before the restriction to the splitting field L, and it consumes the author's fourth description of R-universality through the division algebra D(Lie G, Q)(lambda) (proof lines 934-945). The two external lemmas it invokes, SameFixed and RunivIff, are navigation pointers only; the parts of the argument that use them are one-line appeals. H2.
